title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Teikametrics is revolutionizing retail through our patented Artificial Retail Intelligence platform. Our proprietary orchestration layer functions as prompt intelligence, verticalizing AI for Amazon, Walmart, TikTok, and emerging marketplace use cases. For more information, visit www.teikametrics.com.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Teikametrics is looking for an Account Manager, your core role involves owning and growing a portfolio of advertisers on platforms such as Amazon (AMZN) and Walmart (WMT). You will be responsible for optimizing advertiser accounts across **both Search and Display advertising to achieve their business and advertising goals, while delivering a high-quality customer experience at Teikametrics.**  
  
As a strategic partner to your clients, **you will own the end-to-end customer relationship — from onboarding and account optimization to retention, renewals, upselling new ARI products, and identifying white-space opportunities to drive growth and expansion across your book of business.** You will also have opportunities to lead complex projects, conduct in-depth analyses, test internal tools, and share customer and market insights with our Product and Engineering teams.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 5–6+ years of experience in digital advertising, performance marketing, e-commerce, or customer success/account management, with hands-on Amazon and/or Walmart advertising and optimization across Search and Display; MBA in Marketing/Operations preferred.
* Experience managing global clients and owning individual performance and business goals, with strong knowledge of advertising metrics, campaign optimization, data analysis, and performance marketing.
* Proven ability to manage and grow customer portfolios through renewals, retention, upselling, cross-selling, and expansion, with a strong commercial mindset and ability to identify white-space opportunities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, willingness to work shifts for global markets, and a passion for online business, e-commerce, digital advertising, and customer growth.
* Strong customer-first mindset with the ability to balance advertiser outcomes, customer retention, and commercial growth.

  
**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME**

* Own a portfolio of Standard and High Value advertisers as their strategic partner, understanding business goals, advertising objectives, challenges, and success criteria.
* Drive end-to-end advertising optimization across Amazon and Walmart Search and Display, analyzing performance data and optimizing keywords, bids, budgets, targeting, and campaign structure.
* Monitor account and campaign performance, proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scale, and deliver actionable performance insights and recommendations.
* Own the customer lifecycle, including renewals, retention, and upsell opportunities, by demonstrating value and proactively addressing advertiser needs and risks.
* Identify white-space opportunities across the book of business and partner cross-functionally to drive account growth, expansion, retention, and adoption of Teikametrics solutions.
* Leverage customer feedback, data, emerging needs, and competitive insights to identify product improvements and lead strategic projects with Product and Engineering.

**WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED**

* Every Teikametrics employee is eligible for company equity
* Remote Work Flexibility - Work from home or from our offices, with flexible remote options
* Broadband reimbursement
* Group Medical Insurance – Coverage of INR 7,50,000 per annum for a family

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About SatSure**
-----------------

SatSure is a global Earth intelligence company headquartered in India. Founded in 2017, SatSure operates across the Earth observation data value chain—from payload infrastructure and foundational AI technologies to decision intelligence solutions. We work with private companies and government bodies across agriculture, agri-banking, forestry, critical infrastructure, and aviation.

Through our subsidiary KaleidEO, we are building multispectral payloads for high-definition satellite imagery with edge computing capabilities, supporting sovereign and commercial applications.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong agriculture domain knowledge and hands-on experience in product discovery, solutioning, and zero-to-one product development.

Your primary focus will be identifying unmet customer needs, shaping scalable solutions, and taking new products from discovery through launch. You will use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate development and build reusable capabilities that support future products and use cases. You will also partner with commercial teams to support adoption and expansion within existing accounts.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1.** **Product Discovery**

* Own deep, continuous discovery informed by market shifts, direct customer engagement and feedback, internal stakeholder insights, and the competitive landscape.
* Understand customer workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes through structured interviews, field visits, and usage analysis.
* Identify recurring problems and distinguish individual customer requests from broader product opportunities.
* Test assumptions and validate customer problems and solution concepts through research, prototypes, and targeted experiments.

### **2.** **Solutioning and Product Strategy**

* Translate complex agriculture problems into practical, scalable solutions with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and commercial teams.
* Assess opportunities for customer value, commercial viability, technical feasibility, and data availability.
* Define product strategy and roadmaps with the VP of Product, prioritizing validated opportunities aligned with business goals.
* Translate opportunities into clear requirements, solution concepts, and measurable success criteria.

### **3.** **Zero-to-One Product Development**

* Lead new products from validated problems through prototyping, development, testing, and launch.
* Align cross-functional teams on scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
* Use AI-enabled research, synthesis, prototyping, and development workflows to shorten the journey from discovery to launch.
* Build reusable data, analytics, and product capabilities that reduce development effort across new products and use cases.
* Ensure releases meet agreed customer, usability, and quality requirements, and incorporate early customer feedback into subsequent iterations.

### **4.** **Product Adoption and Account Expansion**

* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to support adoption and identify new use cases within existing accounts.
* Track product usage, customer outcomes, and performance to guide improvements and further discovery.
* Support customer-facing teams with product demonstrations, positioning, and release guidance.

**Must-Have Experience and Skills**
-----------------------------------

* **Agriculture domain expertise:** Strong understanding of customer workflows, industry challenges, and business needs.
* **Zero-to-one product development and solutioning:** Hands-on experience identifying and validating customer problems, shaping scalable solutions with technical and commercial teams, and taking new products through development and launch.
* **Cross-functional delivery:** Experience managing complex product releases in a startup environment using agile practices.
* **Analytical and commercial judgment:** Ability to assess data, customer value, business impact, and product trade-offs.
* **Communication:** Ability to clearly articulate problems, solutions, and priorities and align teams and senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 6 or more years of product management experience.
* B.Tech and MBA from a Tier 1 institution.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Understanding of remote sensing and geospatial technologies.
* People management experience.

**Benefits**
------------

* Opportunity to build data products at the intersection of agriculture, AI, and space technology.
* A flat organizational structure grounded in empathy, problem-solving, integrity, customer focus, and ownership.
* Learning and skill development allowances, broadband and remote work support.
* Medical insurance for you and your family, including unlimited online doctor consultations.
* Access to mental health experts for you and your family.
* Comprehensive leave policy, including casual, paid, marriage, and bereavement leave.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call.
* Interview rounds, typically three to four.
* Culture and HR discussion.

title: Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
* Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
* Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
* Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
* Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
* Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
* Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

**Mandatory:**

* 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
* 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
* Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
* Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
* Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
* Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
* Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
* Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
* Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Web Strategy Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Job Summary**

*Role Purpose*

Candescent is seeking a data-driven Web Strategy Manager to own the performance, structure, and continuous improvement of our website from one of our India office locations. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, design, and technology, translating business goals into a web strategy that drives traffic, conversion, and pipeline.

This is a strategy, prioritisation, and performance role rather than a primarily hands-on build role. You will set the direction and the roadmap, run the experimentation programme, and work through the web development, design, and SEO members of the team to deliver. You will be expected to be technically fluent enough to scope work credibly, review quality, and troubleshoot alongside the team.

This role also acts as a senior point of coordination for the India web team, partnering closely with the US-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, delivery, and stakeholder communication.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

**Web Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end web strategy, roadmap, and performance of the company website.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into a prioritised web roadmap, balancing impact, effort, and dependencies.
* Lead cross-functional web projects from scoping through launch, coordinating with design, content, development, and external vendors.
* Manage project timelines, priorities, and delivery expectations, ensuring commitments are met and risks are surfaced early.

**Experimentation & Conversion Optimisation**

* Design, execute, and analyse A/B and multivariate tests across landing pages, forms, CTAs, and key user flows to improve conversion.
* Build and maintain a testing roadmap prioritised by potential impact and effort, and report results to stakeholders.
* Apply sound experiment design, including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, and statistical significance.

**Search Visibility Direction**

* Set the direction and priorities for SEO and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), working through the SEO Specialist who owns hands-on execution.
* Ensure organic search and AI-driven answer experiences are factored into site structure, content planning, and page launches.
* Hold the team to search best practices across new builds and site changes.

**Measurement & Reporting**

* Monitor and report on site performance using Google Analytics (GA4), building dashboards and surfacing actionable insight for leadership.

**Collaboration & Ways of Working**

* Coordinate closely with the US-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Provide direction, review, and quality oversight to the web development, design, and SEO members of the India team.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**

* 6–9 years of experience in web strategy, digital marketing, growth marketing, or a related discipline, including experience setting direction rather than only executing.
* Proven, hands-on experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation, including experiment design and interpreting statistical significance.
* Strong working knowledge of SEO fundamentals across technical, on-page, and content, and familiarity with emerging AEO practices.
* Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4), including custom reports, funnels, and attribution.

* Strong project management skills, with the ability to run multiple concurrent projects and keep cross-functional teams on track.
* Experience guiding, reviewing, or coordinating the work of other specialists such as developers, designers, or analysts.
* Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations, with strong written and verbal communication.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**

*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with testing and optimisation platforms such as Optimizely or VWO is preferred.
* Basic HTML and CSS knowledge for troubleshooting Webflow builds is preferred.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, or Asana is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A prioritised, consistently executed testing roadmap that improves key conversion metrics quarter over quarter.
* Measurable growth in organic search traffic and visibility, including AI-driven search surfaces.
* A well-maintained, fast, and reliable website with minimal downtime or technical debt.
* Web projects delivered on time, with clear scope and predictable quality.

* Technical fluency sufficient to earn credibility with developers and designers.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.

Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
* Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
* Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
* Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

**Rapid Prototyping with AI**

* Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
* Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

**Execution & Team Leadership**

* Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
* Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
* Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

**Mobile & Distribution**

* Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
* Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
* Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

**Mandatory:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
* Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
* Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
* Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
* Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.
* Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.
* Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
* A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.
* You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:**

* Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.
* Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.
* Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.
* A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.
* Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).
* A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.
* An engineering background or computer science degree.
* Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

**Why this role:**

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

description:
Senior Technical Product Manager, Networking and Switches


Reports To: VP of Products  

Location: Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India (preferred for direct access to our hardware labs), or Remote (US).  

Travel: 20%


What You Will Do

* Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high\-margin lines to scale.
* OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root\-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
* Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
* Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands\-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
* Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
* Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End\-of\-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
* Cross\-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.


Core Technical Expertise

* Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802\.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802\.1X and ACLs.
* Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP\+, RJ\-45, single\-mode vs. multi\-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate\-matching mechanics.
* PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802\.3af, 802\.3at, intelligent detection and backward\-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
* Harsh\-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN\-rail or panel\-mount deployment.
* Out\-of\-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out\-of\-band access, terminal emulation, serial\-over\-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
* Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2\.0, FIPS 140\-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA\-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS\+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802\.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out\-of\-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
* Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS\-232, RS\-422, RS\-485\) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long\-distance copper extension.
* OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS\-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (e.g., 2\-kV), and surge protection.


Who Will Succeed in This Role

* You are a hands\-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning\-tree loop in the lab.
* You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
* You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.


EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

### **Job Description:**

### **Let me tell you about the role**


### **A Product Manager takes ownership of overall product and portfolio success, focusing on understanding customer needs and identifying opportunities to significantly improve its experience. This role involves defining product strategy, crafting a compelling vision, and driving the product lifecycle from concept to launch and scaling. Collaboration is key, working closely with engineers, designers, and business partners to deliver impactful solutions. ### **What you will deliver**


### **Business focused:**


* ### **Analytical and commercially focused, using data\-driven insights, metrics, and analytics to evaluate product performance and link outcomes to strategy**
* ### **Clearly define why we are pushing a product, considering market, competitor, technical, and operational aspects of bp’s strategy and vision**
* ### **Understand business and technical economic value, such as TCO, unit economics, NPV, ROIC, and other commercial measures**
* ### **Translate vision into strategic product roadmaps with an agile delivery approach in partnership with Tech while handling cyber, operational, and/or regulatory risks**

Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

**About Teamified**


Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-


scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and


accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high


performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,


designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

**About The Role**


We're looking for a mid\-level Product Manager to join us in working directly


with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.


This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.

**What you'll work on**

* Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer\-raised asks and requests
* Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
* Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
* Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform\-appropriate design
* Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
* Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
* Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
* Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs

  

**Requirements** **What you bring**

* 3\-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
* Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
* Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade\-offs behind them
* Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
* Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
* Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
* Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces

**Nice to have**

* Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
* Data\-driven decision making
* Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
* Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback

**Why this role matters**


This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.

 **Benefits**  

* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity
